title: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient kor planeswalker and lithomancer who recruits an adventuring party to retrieve the Lithoform Core from the Murasa Skyclave.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A renowned kor line-slinger and leader of an adventuring party from the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Zareth
entities.description: A merfolk adventurer with shock-red hair, Akiri's partner, who distrusts Nahiri and steals her key during a card game.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A small human wizard who adores fire and is a member of Akiri's party.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: A kor cleric with a long white beard who lost his family to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: The tall kor head of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House who wears the Dragon's Frill and has her own doubts about Nahiri.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who follows Kesenya's hint to Murasa to find Nissa and Nahiri.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who summons a harabaz elemental to save Jace and vows to protect elementals from Nahiri.

entities.name: Mara
entities.description: A scarred veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate who invites Jace to the memorial.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A dead Gatewatch planeswalker remembered by Jace and Nissa.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Jace cannot reach.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A fierce general in the battle against the Eldrazi, now hunting a beast in Guul Draz.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker with whom Jace survived Ixalan.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose corruption spilled over Sea Gate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The world-eating beings whose war razed Sea Gate.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Jace tries to rally.

entities.name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
entities.description: The Sea Gate adventurers' guild led by Kesenya, bearing a Dragon's Frill emblem.

entities.name: Harabaz Elemental
entities.description: A tree-like elemental summoned by Nissa that destroys the mushroom-controlled monster.

entities.name: Stomper
entities.description: A six-legged beast frozen and turned to sand by the key's power.

entities.name: Mushroom-backed monster
entities.description: A six-legged crablike monster with mushrooms on its back that uses echolocation and attacks Jace.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Nahiri, Nissa and Jace converge on.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The rebuilt coastal city on Zendikar, scarred by the Eldrazi war.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A Zendikari island where a newly risen Skyclave holds the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: A massive ancient floating ruin covered in greenery above Sunder Bay.

entities.name: Sunder Bay
entities.description: The shore on Murasa where the adventurers and Jace arrive.

entities.name: Akoum Skyclave
entities.description: The earlier Skyclave where Nahiri and Nissa found the key.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A Zendikari region where Tazri is hunting a beast.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A jungle plane where Jace was trapped.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Jace spoke with Nissa.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: An ancient powerful object Nahiri says will heal Zendikar.

entities.name: Skyclave key
entities.description: The glowing key Nahiri obtained from the Akoum Skyclave.

entities.name: Dragon's Frill
entities.description: A legendary brilliant red necklace worn by Kesenya and emblem of the Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Conquest
entities.description: A card game played by adventuring parties where players tell true stories to claim cards.

entities.name: Sea Gate war memorial
entities.description: A platform with six hedrons amid wreckage commemorating the Eldrazi war dead.

events.summary: Nahiri arrives in Sea Gate, aware she cannot reach the Murasa Skyclave alone after relying on Nissa in Akoum.
events.quote: she could not visit the Murasa Skyclave alone and hope to survive

events.summary: Nahiri meets Expeditionary House head Kesenya, who calls her Benefactor, and asks for a brave team.
events.quote: And now I need a brave and capable team to retrieve something very precious and very powerful.

events.summary: Nahiri pitches Akiri's party on retrieving the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, claiming it will heal Zendikar.
events.quote: The object I seek will heal Zendikar of all its scars.

events.summary: Nahiri shows the key, and Zareth proposes a card game of Conquest.
events.quote: Adventuring parties like to call this little game Conquest .

events.summary: During the game Zareth picks Nahiri's pocket for the key; she turns the cards to granite and demands it back.
events.quote: Then she snapped her fingers and turned all the cards to granite.

events.summary: Akiri's party agrees to depart at first light.
Zareth confides to Kesenya that he fears what the Core will do and asks her to find a buyer, planning to steal it.
events.quote: All I'm asking you to do is find a buyer for the Core who is rich and stupid.

events.summary: The party and Nahiri arrive at Sunder Bay on Murasa below the Skyclave.
events.quote: When they finally arrived at Sunder Bay on Murasa

events.summary: Nahiri freezes a stomper with the key's power and turns it to sand, and the key's power spreads stone-like blight under a tree.
events.quote: is just a taste of the Core's power.

events.summary: Jace arrives in Sea Gate looking for Nissa and meets Mara at the memorial.
events.quote: Together, they walked to the massive platform with its six upright hedrons.

events.summary: Jace discloses the situation to Kesenya, who refuses help but secretly writes Murasa on a note.
events.quote: But scrawled on the bottom of the parchment, there was a single word: Murasa .

events.summary: Jace arrives on Murasa and is attacked by a mushroom-backed monster using echolocation.
events.quote: Something large was tearing through the fauna behind him

events.summary: Nissa's harabaz elemental destroys the monster, saving Jace.
events.quote: Within seconds, the harabaz elemental destroyed the monster

events.summary: Jace agrees to join Nissa in climbing the Skyclave to stop Nahiri.

relations.note: She is the head of the house.
relations.quote: sat Kesenya, the head of the expeditionary house

relations.note: Kesenya addresses Nahiri as her benefactor and investor.
relations.quote: I'm pleased to see my investment is flourishing

relations.note: They show affection and hold hands.
relations.quote: He grinned up at her with affection, placing his hand on top of hers.

relations.note: Akiri leads the adventuring party of four.
relations.quote: She, Nahiri could tell, was their leader.

relations.note: Zareth distrusts and works against Nahiri's plans.

relations.quote: I've never summoned a harabaz elemental before.

relations.note: Jace offers to help protect the elementals.
relations.quote: so I'll help you protect them.

relations.note: Nahiri says she fought a world-ending battle.
relations.quote: just like it was before the Eldrazi arrived.
